about: How the Categories tab lays out the taxonomy: shelves in screen order, each with its cards; a card is a taxonomy category (by id) or a gathered space, and its groups list tiles by id ('from' takes every subtopic of a category). 'moved' sends retired card ids to their new home (saved Read-from choices follow it); 'hidden' keeps situations off screen with a reason. Labels are never changed here. See docs/plans/categories/DECISIONS.md.
